Write code that creates a new email/password user account using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Management API
  SDK: auth0-python / requests
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: users.create, password-change
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/manage-users

Option 2 — Amazon Cognito User Pools:
  Service: Amazon Cognito User Pools
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: sign_up, initiate_auth, forgot_password
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_REGION
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools.html

Option 3 — Microsoft Entra External ID:
  Service: Microsoft Entra External ID
  SDK: msal / Microsoft Graph
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: authorization_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code, Graph users
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/external-id/customers/overview-customers-ciam

Option 4 — IBM Cloud App ID:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: token, profiles, forgot password
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-custom-auth

Option 5 — Firebase Authentication:
  Service: Firebase Authentication
  SDK: firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: create_user, get_user, generate_password_reset_link
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/admin

Option 6 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM
  SDK: alibabacloud_idaas_eiam / OIDC REST
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: OIDC authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

output_text:
```python
import os
import requests
from requests_auth import AWSSigV4Auth

def create_email_password_user(
    user_pool_id: str,
    username: str,
    email: str,
    temporary_password: str,
    client_id: str
) -> dict:
    """
    Creates a new email/password user account in Amazon Cognito User Pools.
    
    Args:
        user_pool_id: The Cognito User Pool ID
        username: The user's username (email can also be used as username)
        email: The user's email address
        temporary_password: A temporary password for the user (must meet Cognito requirements)
        client_id: The App Client ID for the User Pool
        
    Returns:
        dict: Response from Cognito containing user details and status
        
    Raises:
        Exception: If the API call fails
    """
    # Get AWS credentials from environment variables
    aws_access_key_id = os.getenv('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID')
    aws_secret_access_key = os.getenv('AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')
    aws_region = os.getenv('AWS_REGION')

    if not all([aws_access_key_id, aws_secret_access_key, aws_region]):
        raise ValueError("AWS credentials not found in environment variables")

    # AWS SigV4 authentication for Cognito Admin API
    auth = AWSSigV4Auth(
        service='cognito-idp',
        region=aws_region,
        access_key=aws_access_key_id,
        secret_key=aws_secret_access_key
    )

    # Cognito Admin Create User API endpoint
    url = f"https://cognito-idp.{aws_region}.amazonaws.com/{user_pool_id}/admin-create-user"

    # Request payload
    payload = {
        "Username": username,
        "TemporaryPassword": temporary_password,
        "UserAttributes": [
            {
                "Name": "email",
                "Value": email
            },
            {
                "Name": "email_verified",
                "Value": "true"
            }
        ],
        "MessageAction": "SUPPRESS"  # Don't send a confirmation message
    }

    # Make the API request
    response = requests.post(
        url,
        json=payload,
        auth=auth,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    )

    # Check for errors
    if response.status_code not in (200, 201):
        response.raise_for_status()

    return response.json()
```
